hypothesis: On Pangaea, qd1n can freeze on upgrades while land is flat, troop capacity is nearly full, no transport is active, and legal naval conversion exists. A safe non-K1Z boat may convert otherwise wasted regeneration into territory, but production code requires one complete raw selector request before the action can be chosen faithfully.
causal_mechanism: After four consecutive flat upgrades at own troopRatio at least 0.90, retain the exact observation and full legal-action objects before selection. This acquisition phase changes logging only and cannot alter the selected action.

public_replay_limit.reason: The replay omits the raw observation and full offered LegalAction objects. Tactical affordances are computed after qd1n responds. Filling target ratios, source tiles, per-action risk, or legal reasons from later state would fabricate selector input.

historical_recurrence.query_definition: Odin episode with at least 20 decisions where banking_recommended=true and selected action_kind=upgrade_structure

capture_contract.instrumentation: A hash-checking build script derives from the verified live image and adds one environment-gated stdout record containing requestID, observation, legalActions, and compact selector history. Strategy-engine and action selection stay byte-identical to live.

discarded_prebuild.reason: The branch was based on source commit 1ccaff73, whose strategy SHA256 52d156a3... differs from live qd1n:v89 f2ee66d5.... It is excluded from evidence.

capture_pass: At least one policy log contains exactly one CB1_RAW_REQUEST_V1 record.
The record includes the complete raw observation and all legal-action objects before selection.
The record satisfies the sealed trigger using only fields present in that request.
At least one legal non-K1Z boat contains targetID, targetName, relativeTroopRatio, troopPercent, risk, and legalReason.
The strategy-engine bytes match exact parent and all parent tests pass.
capture_stop: No trigger reaches in the single preregistered job.
The log omits or truncates raw observation or legal actions.
No legal boat can be resolved safely away from K1Z.
Any policy selection code differs from exact parent.
promotion_boundary: Raw capture can only make CB1 source-ready. It cannot justify a matched pair, upload, hosted request, regression, submission, membership, or champion change.
forbidden: Use post-decision tacticalAffordances as if they were policy input.
Invent missing boat metadata from later replay state.
Tune or run a second seed after zero capture without a new preregistration.
Mutate qd1n:v89 or any league state.
